entries.03bf3e2b1d412617: Its customers are financial institutions, retail and distribution companies, major SI providers and general business companies. Major customers include NTT DATA Corporation and Nomura Research Institute, Ltd.
entries.086be35d2644ce02: Consulting, implementation and operational support for ServiceNow
entries.0b6f539b2d0bb282: The company's strengths are its ability to provide end-to-end services for ServiceNow from consulting through implementation and operation, its strength in Oracle Corporation's cloud infrastructure "Oracle Cloud Infrastructure" and cloud-based ERP "Oracle NetSuite" and "Oracle Fusion Applications," and its ability to lead seamlessly from DX diagnosis through data analysis to system development.
entries.0f6a0df5694fb165: This business leverages knowledge and know-how of client operations and the company's original service U-Way. For financial institutions and retail and distribution companies, it undertakes the design, development, operation and maintenance of business applications and proposes data analysis and utilization, while for general business companies it provides everything from infrastructure to application development through U-Way. It has strengths in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, a cloud service provided by Oracle, and in the cloud ERP products Oracle NetSuite and Oracle Fusion Applications. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥3,459 million.

entries.b2fa98f3149494d2: The company is pursuing its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended May 2025 to May 2027) and, based on its basic policy of "promoting empowerment and fostering innovation," is working on five strategies: strengthening its business foundation, expanding business scale by acquiring new customers, expanding the market by enhancing its solutions, strengthening proposal capabilities to create new business opportunities, and creating business starting from social issues. As its target image for the fiscal year ending May 2030, the company has set out the aim of being "a corporate group that contributes to people, society and the future by solving social issues through businesses and services that 'think of people.'"
